items.q: Is UniTracker free for students in India?
items.a: Yes — completely free, forever. No ads, no subscriptions, and no features locked behind a paywall. It's open source (MIT license).

items.q: Can I use it for JEE or NEET preparation?
items.a: Absolutely. Use the Pomodoro timer for focused study blocks, create tasks per chapter, and check analytics to see how many real hours you give to Physics, Chemistry, Maths or Biology each week.
Yes. UniTracker is offline-first — every feature works without a connection and syncs to the cloud when you're back online. Ideal for hostels and low-connectivity areas.

items.q: Do I need to download an app?
items.a: No download needed — it runs in your browser on any phone or laptop. You can also install it as a PWA from Chrome for an app-like experience.

items.q: How is it different from other study apps?
items.a: Everything is in one place: Pomodoro, study timer, tasks, calendar, notes, habits and analytics. Nothing distracts you — no feed, no ads, no premium nagging.

about.title: About UniTracker
about.storyBody: UniTracker was born in December 2024 from a simple idea: to create a better way to manage university assignments and tasks. As a student myself, I noticed the need for a tool that could help organize academic work more effectively while being intuitive and user-friendly.
about.aboutMeBody: Hi! I'm Ricky, the creator of UniTracker. I'm passionate about building tools that make life easier for students. This project represents my commitment to improving the academic experience through technology.
about.getInTouchBody: I'm always open to feedback, suggestions, or just a friendly chat about the app. Whether you've found a bug, have a feature request, or want to share your experience, I'd love to hear from you!
about.thankYou: Thank you for using UniTracker! Your support and feedback help make this app better!
